POWER-FLOW SCREENING (pandapower DC)
Base 2025 — 3,117 MW · max 100% · 1 line at limit. Secure.
Targeted 2035 (data centers + Kuna/Meridian growth, not uniform) — 4,455 MW · max 486% · 6 over. Worst: Bowmont→Hemingway tie, TAP→Kuna feeders.
+ IRP build (B2H 500 kV → Hemingway · Bowmont–Hubbard 230 kV) — max 146% · 2 over. Cleared: Bowmont–Hemingway 486→30%, TAP–Kuna 259→85%. Residual: Boise Bench 146%.
pandapower DC power flow on HIFLD/EIA topology; growth nodes from Idaho Power 2025 IRP + data-center filings; ratings calibrated so present base peaks at 100%. Screening — relative stress.

Climate risk mid-century

Warming to ~2051 (LOCA2 / IPCC AR6): +1.1 °C SSP2-4.5 / +1.8 °C SSP5-8.5 MODELED-CITED. Cooling degree-days +22–38% → higher A/C peak. Hydro availability falls 0.55 → 0.24 in severe drought MODELED.
Compounding: summer heat lifts demand while de-rating the same conductors, and drought pushes groundwater-pumping load onto ag feeders.

Transmission Model Review

Substation load clusters use population-to-load assignment, sector-wise load shares, load factor peak conversion, real-time EIA demand scaling, ideal transformer handling, and steady-state DC power-flow internals.
Generation assumptions are shown separately from slack imports. Open PF Internals for the Ybus matrix and Voltage / angle by bus table.
